basic_details.job_title: HLL Operations Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: HLL Lifecare Limited, a Government of India enterprise under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, is recruiting one Operations Manager (Electrical) for its HCD (Projects & Services – Division) on an Executive – Fixed Term Contract, with posting at Chennai. Basic pay is Rs. 30,000 – 50,000 per month. BE / B.Tech in Electrical or Diploma in Engineering (Electrical) with experience is required. Applications open from 03.11.2026 and the last date is 18.11.2026, through a Google Form.

The notice says the date for determining the age limit is the same as the cut-off date for calculating qualification and post-qualification experience.

content_sections.heading: About HLL
content_sections.text: HLL Lifecare Limited is a Government of India enterprise under the administrative control of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, and commenced operations on 5 April 1969. The notice describes it as an integrated healthcare organisation with a presence in healthcare manufacturing, retail pharmacy, diagnostics, imaging services, healthcare infrastructure development, procurement consultancy, hospital management and allied services. It gives the HLL Group's annual business turnover as approximately ₹6,500 crore.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The post is open to Indian Nationals only. Candidates holding either of the two essential qualifications below may apply, each with its own experience requirement and age limit. The experience, for both degree and diploma holders, must be in the planning, design, engineering, execution, installation, testing, commissioning, operation and maintenance of electrical infrastructure for hospitals, medical colleges, super-specialty healthcare facilities, diagnostic centres, laboratories and allied healthcare projects. SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates are eligible for relaxation as per Government of India directives. The notice says the date for determining the age limit is the same as the cut-off date for calculating qualification and post-qualification experience. HT/LT Substations and Power Distribution Systems. 11 kV/33 kV HT Installations and Transformers. LT Panels, PCC, MCC, MDB and Distribution Boards. DG Sets, AMF, ATS and Emergency Power Systems. UPS, Battery Banks and Critical Power Distribution. Earthing, Lightning Protection and Electrical Safety. Electrical Load Estimation and Power System Design. Healthcare Electrical Infrastructure and Critical Area Power Requirements. ELV, BMS and Building Services Coordination. Testing, Commissioning and Preventive Maintenance. AutoCAD, electrical design software and MS Office. Tendering, BOQ Preparation and Contract Management. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: HLL Operations Manager (Electrical) Job Description
content_sections.text: Design: Prepare and review electrical designs, SLDs, load calculations, BOQs and estimates, coordinating with architects and other engineering teams. HT/LT systems: Design, supervise and commission 11/33 kV substations, transformers, panels and LT distribution, with proper earthing and IS compliance. Critical power: Ensure uninterrupted, redundant supply (DG, AMF, ATS, UPS) to OTs, ICUs, cath labs, MRI/CT, emergency and other critical areas. Building services: Coordinate power needs for HVAC, lifts, fire-fighting, labs (BSL-2/3) and ELV systems such as fire alarm, CCTV, BMS and nurse call. Execution: Supervise contractors, review submittals and drawings, run integrated testing and commissioning, and ensure handover documentation. O&M: Plan preventive and predictive maintenance, monitor load and energy use, manage AMC/OEMs and keep statutory records. Tendering: Prepare specifications and tenders, evaluate bids and monitor contractor performance. Safety and compliance: Follow CEA, NEC and IS standards, obtain statutory approvals, and implement LOTO and permit-to-work.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HLL Operations Manager (Electrical)
content_sections.text: Access the Google Form using the application link in the notice. Download the prescribed job application form from the link provided in the form or from the HLL website. Fill in the application form digitally and save it as a PDF or Word file. Handwritten applications will not be accepted. Upload the completed application form using the file upload option in the Google Form. Maximum upload size is 10 MB per file. Attach additional supporting documents in PDF or Word format if required (CV, educational/experience certificates, latest salary slip), each file under 10 MB. Select the correct post applied for in the form. Submit the form on or before the deadline. Late submissions will not be considered. The job title and the reference code HLL/HR/105/2026 must be clearly mentioned in the application form.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice says all information in the application will be verified with original documents at the time of the interview. Candidates working in Government, Semi-Government Organizations, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies must provide a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of the interview. The notice does not give an interview date or the stages of selection. HLL reserves the right to cancel, restrict or modify the selection process, and the decision of Management regarding selection will be final.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in HLL Operations Manager (Electrical) recruitment?
faq.answer: There is 1 position of Operations Manager (Electrical), with posting at Chennai.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 18.11.2026. Applications opened on 03.11.2026, and late submissions will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: BE / B.Tech in Electrical OR Diploma in Engineering (Electrical). Degree holders need minimum 3 years of post-qualification experience and Diploma holders minimum 10 years, in electrical infrastructure for hospitals and allied healthcare projects.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 40 years for BE / B.Tech holders and 45 years for Diploma holders, as on 01.11.2026. SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates get relaxation as per Government of India directives.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The basic pay range is Rs. 30,000 – 50,000 per month. Gross salary is Rs. 64,830.00 (Metro) (approx.) and annual CTC is 9.18 Lakhs (Metro) (approx.), both at the minimum of the scale.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply through the Google Form: download the prescribed application form, fill it digitally, save it as PDF or Word, and upload it. Supporting documents such as CV, certificates and latest salary slip may be attached if required.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The contract type is Executive – Fixed Term Contract.

faq.question: Q8. Can I submit a handwritten application?
faq.answer: No. The form must be filled in digitally and saved as a PDF or Word file; handwritten applications will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q9. Do government employees need an NOC?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates working in Government, Semi-Government Organizations, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies must provide a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Who can apply for this post?
faq.answer: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply, provided they meet the qualification, experience and age conditions.
